## Hypothesis

The edge we are trying to capture is the removal of wrong-way trades when the market is in a trending environment. This candidate proposes the use of a new veto primitive that blocks P-in-uptrend and C-in-downtrend trades, with the goal of improving the overall performance of the engine.

## Mechanism

The mechanism for this candidate involves the use of a new veto primitive that checks the trend direction of the market before entering a trade. If the trend direction is not favorable for the trade, the veto primitive will block the trade. The trend direction is determined by the `crypto.lib.market_structure.classify_trend` function, which uses a 5-minute timeframe to classify the trend as uptrend, downtrend, or range.
